assets.name: workspace
assets.prompt: Use case: productivity-visual. Create a single polished small enterprise UI illustration, 1024 square canvas, truly transparent background. Subject: a calm organized workspace, an open laptop with a few abstract interface blocks on the screen, two neatly stacked document sheets beside it, and a small ceramic plant pot. Isolated centered still life, whole subject visible with generous transparent margin, occupies about 75 percent of canvas. Style: refined minimal softly dimensional editorial illustration, pale cool-gray paper and matte ceramic, fine restrained slate-gray outlines, gentle ambient shading, mostly frontal slight isometric view. Entire palette strictly neutral grayscale and slate gray with no saturated brand colors, no warm brown or skin colors. Must work on both very light and very dark interfaces and at 160px size. No background panel, no gradient backdrop, no text, letters, numbers, logos or watermark, no people. Clear recognizable silhouettes, not photorealistic. This will become a faint sidebar decoration and a reusable workspace/onboarding graphic. Do not draw a UI page around the illustration.
